sources.title: Efficient Blockwise Permutation Tests Preserving Exchangeability
sources.venue: International Journal of Statistics in Medical Research 3(2):145?152
sources.access: Search result displayed authors, journal, year, pages, DOI, and abstract; the article page was not separately opened for this package.
